AuthorizationRevokeOperation.description: Revoke an unused Worker grant. Revocation never launches or completes work.
AuthorizationRevokeOperation.title: AuthorizationRevokeOperation

ConclusionRecordOperation.description: Record a human conclusion. The system never supplies the judgement.
ConclusionRecordOperation.title: ConclusionRecordOperation

EvaluationCompareOperation.description: Compare a baseline and a candidate result, refusing incompatible setups.
EvaluationCompareOperation.title: EvaluationCompareOperation

EvaluationRunOperation.description: Compute the labelled synthetic CPU contract fixture, without training.
EvaluationRunOperation.title: EvaluationRunOperation

PlanPreflightOperation.description:
Show what a plan would require, without authorizing anything.

The browser must be able to display exact plan identity, target,
permissions, supported/enforced limits and resource or budget requirements
*before* a human authorizes it. This operation therefore reads only: it
mints no grant, records no fact, and never reports a launch as allowed.
PlanPreflightOperation.title: PlanPreflightOperation

ProposalSubmitOperation.description:
Append one proposal bound to a base revision and a server-derived diff.

The document supplies its own ``experimentRevision``; a proposal whose
revision is not the current head is refused, so a stale proposal cannot
overwrite a newer revision.
ProposalSubmitOperation.title: ProposalSubmitOperation

ProposalValidateOperation.description:
Validate one proposal document and resolve its citations. Appends nothing.

Generated or hand-written proposal text becomes a draft only after it has
passed this check, so an unresolved citation is refused before a proposal can
exist, rather than being discovered later.
ProposalValidateOperation.title: ProposalValidateOperation

RunCancelOperation.description:
Request cancellation of a Run or one active Attempt.

A request is not an outcome. The receipt reports that the request was
committed; the observed stop, if any, arrives as a later fact.
RunCancelOperation.title: RunCancelOperation

title: ApplicationCommand
